zh.title: 说明
items: 本轮围绕「未知执行结果」完成了一条从源头登记到自主收口的完整链路（ADR 127）：工具派发先登记回执、宿主可对账、用户可按 Bot 委托收口；同时合入资源工作区目录标签、叙述/交付拆分（ADR 87）与多处稳定性修复。

zh.title: 新功能
items: 未知结果收口策略：每个机器人可设置「每次询问我」或「主 Bot 核对后直接收口」。开启后，主 Bot 在宿主核对证据完整（无未结束句柄、录制进程已死、声明范围内无 Git 可见变化）时可直接结束未知结果的资源占用，不再逐次询问；收口只结束占用，不会把结果标成成功，撤回后已收口的不重开。
询问卡新增「宿主核对结论」与「今后由主 Bot 核对后直接收口」的一键委托入口；任务详情的未知结果保护现在指名具体文件（「涉及文件 /path」），不再笼统锁整个目录。
资源工作区支持一级目录标签（ADR 125），可在多个目录间切换浏览。
主 Bot 回复中叙述性内容与交付答案分离呈现（ADR 87）。

zh.title: 优化
items: 工具调用在派发前登记带稳定标识的回执，按「已结果 / 已终止 / 未派发」分类结算；崩溃重启后同一收口不重复、不复活。
文件级声明范围使未知结果只保护真正涉及的文件：新任务可在同目录开工，写入被保护文件仍会被拒绝。
诊断指标：可观测未知率、停滞（stale）占用与收口事实，便于排查历史遗留。

zh.title: 修复
items: 同一轮回复不再叠加出现第二个空头像。
禁用状态的文件工具栏按钮不再持续旋转。
裸启动器标签页隐藏头部导航入口。
重复改写的 Bot 回复只显示一次。
询问卡的资源释放按钮只在宿主确实可闭包时出现，并展示释放后果。
崩溃窗口遗留的镜像闭包能被正确结算；跟进退役后释放仍可用。

zh.title: 已知问题
items: 崩溃恢复后的旧记录若缺少派发登记，仍需人工确认释放（保守策略，后续版本提供基线对比后自动判定）。

en.title: Notes
items: This release ships the end-to-end "unknown outcome" chain (ADR 127): dispatch receipts are registered before execution, the host can reconcile them with bounded probes, and users may delegate closure to the main bot. It also includes resource workspace directory tabs (ADR 125), the narration/delivery split (ADR 87), and several stability fixes.

en.title: New Features
items: Per-bot unknown-outcome closure policy: "Ask me every time" or "Main bot closes after reconciliation". When delegated, the main bot can end unknown-outcome resource occupancy once host reconciliation evidence is complete (no open handles, recorder proven dead, no Git-visible change within the declared scope) without asking each time. Closure ends occupancy only — it never marks a result successful, and revoking keeps already-closed claims closed.

The ask card now shows the host reconciliation verdict and a one-click "delegate to the main bot" entry; task details name the exact file an unknown outcome protects ("Affected file /path") instead of holding the whole directory.
First-class directory tabs in the resource workspace (ADR 125).
Narration is now separated from delivered answers in main-bot replies (ADR 87).

en.title: Improvements
items: Tool calls register a receipt with a stable dispatch id before dispatch and settle with a classification (resulted / terminated / not dispatched); after a crash and restart the same closure is never duplicated or revived.
File-level declared scopes protect only the files actually involved: sibling tasks may start in the same directory while writes to a protected file are still denied.
Diagnostics expose the unknown rate, stale occupancy and closure facts for legacy triage.

en.title: Fixes
items: A second empty avatar no longer stacks within the same reply turn.
Disabled file-toolbar buttons no longer spin indefinitely.
Header navigation entries are hidden on a bare launcher tab.
Restated bot replies display only once.
The claim-release action on ask cards appears only when the host can actually close, and shows the consequences.
Mirrored closures left by crash windows settle correctly; release remains available after follow-up retirement.

en.title: Known Issues
items: Legacy records recovered from crashes without dispatch registration still require manual release confirmation (conservative by design; automatic verdicts await baseline comparison in a later release).
